rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) suffered bodily injury due to a hazardous condition (icy walkway) on the policyholder's premises.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and broke her wrist on the policyholder's icy front walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. Pediatric injury with significant recovery needs.

case_facts.description: slipped and fell on icy walkway, broke wrist
